ADAPTATION OVER SIX ERAS | G2-G3, G5-G6 | analytical time axis
|
+-- Expand | 2018-Q1 2020
|   +-- [S] 2019: SFN early in a five-year plan [a]
|   +-- [S] Q1 2020: product-market fit before planned 2021 scale [b]
|                     |
|                     +--[C:claim]--> planned logistics expansion
+-- Surge | Q2 2020-Q1 2021
|   +-- [S] Q2 2020 GMV growth primarily from COVID shift online [c]
|   +-- [I] External demand shock complicates flywheel attribution
|
+-- Build-ahead | Q2 2021-Q2 2022
|   +-- [S] Q4 2021: SFN prototype -> build; more operated facilities [d]
|   +-- [S] Q1 2022 call: Deliverr acquisition announced [e]
|   +-- [S] Aim: integrated software and end-to-end logistics [e]
|
+-- Reckoning | Q3 2022-Q2 2023
|   +-- [R] July 2022: headcount cut about 10%; structural expansion not realized [f]
|   +-- [S] 2023: sale of most logistics to preferred partner Flexport announced [g]
|   +-- [R] FY23 impairment on logistics sales: $1.340B [h]
|   +-- [I] Owned-logistics strategy pivoted; original horizon curtailed
|   +-- Sale -[C:claim]-> focus on commerce software and partners [g]
|
+-- Focused compounding | Q3 2023-Q1 2025
|   +-- [S] Q1 2024: flat headcount for three quarters [i]
|   +-- [S] Revenue growth excluding logistics: 25% [i]
|   +-- [I] Growth and discipline coexist; no unique causal attribution
|
+-- Reacceleration | Q2 2025 onward
    +-- [S] Q2 2025 GMV: $88B, +31%; +29% constant currency [j]
    +-- [S] Q3 2026 GMV: $119B, +29.5%; FCF margin 22% [k]
    +-- [S] Q3 2026: sixth quarter near 30% constant-currency growth [l]
    +-- [I] Subsequent growth does not prove the exit caused it
